_comment: Documentational manifest only. Trae IDE does NOT scan for plugin.json or marketplace.json — its AI assets (skills/commands/hooks/rules) are loose files under ~/.trae-cn/ (global) and .trae/ (project). The installer that laid them (caveman4cn upstream) has been retired, so Trae currently has no install channel for this plugin; this manifest remains to declare intent and keep the hooks/trae build in sync via scripts/sync-shared.js.
name: caveman
description: Trae IDE 的超压缩通信模式。删废话，保技术准确。支持 lite、full、ultra、wenyan-lite、wenyan-full、wenyan-ultra 强度级别。
